physical.title: print
physical.summary: Inscribed propaganda relief-print, hand-coloured with fibre-tipped pen on machine-made paper. Three women (one with a traditional hat), carrying books, a wheel and a chicken; and a small boy, called a 'thieu sinh quan' or small soldier (he has a gun and he is wearing a military hat and bag) offering gifts to a fit soldier, wearing a padded cotton waistcoat and helmet. These gifts include a traditional cake called 'banh chung', normally given at Spring Festival (lunar New Year). Signed with an unidentified seal monogram and inscribed.
